$comment: Reviewed exceptions to detect_capability_changes.py's BLOCKING classification (AAASM-5602), in ADR 0034 Decision 10's own field shape (id/rule/text/scope/justification/evidence/approver/issued/expires) -- reused verbatim from official-website/scripts/claim-waivers.json's own field set, per claim-vocabulary.md 7.1's licence for each caller to state what a field means for its own rule shape without adding a field. `rule` here is a capability id (e.g. 'S6'), since this gate's rule shape is one manifest row, not a phrase catalogue or a D-dimension tuple. Interim location: agent-assembly has no TRUTH-ADOPTION.md yet (that rollout is AAASM-5605/5607's, not this ticket's), so exceptions live here under the same key name (`exceptions`) the ADR uses -- moving them into TRUTH-ADOPTION.md's front matter later is a relocation, not a redesign. A capability whose coverage/protection_state broadening has no genuine review yet must never get a waiver here to make the gate pass silently -- a waiver records that a human looked at the specific row and accepted it, with an expiry, not a way to mute the gate.
